GREEN: named call-time indirections mirroring access_check._retry_sleep/_default_client (83f0757b12): _ref_lock._default_sleep (steal), _advisory_lock._default_sleep (steal_pass_lock), _jscpd._default_run (run_jscpd). Explicit sleep_fn=/run= injection still wins (covered by new + existing tests). Validation: 538 targeted tests pass, make lint OK, make typecheck OK, complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0. Note: test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote failed locally on clean origin/main too — root-caused as ENVIRONMENTAL: this agent harness injects GIT_CONFIG_COUNT env (safe.bareRepository=explicit) which breaks bare-repo access in tests; passes with those vars unset.
